title: Dele_Multisound_NOAA_Castellote_01 (beluga whale)
author: NOAA Fisheries (M. Castellote)
changes: Beluga whale (Delphinapterus leucas) whistling underwater, an arched whistle followed by quieter calls, from a NOAA hydrophone recording. Trimmed to 18.35–20.85 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. US government work (NOAA Fisheries 'Sounds in the Ocean' library). No high-pass: the recording has no measured low rumble.
